note: PAPER ONLY. Every SQ2 rule ENTERS INTRADAY (buy-stop / VWAP reclaim during the session), so newSignals is always empty: scan.mjs TRY SMALL places next-open orders, which these rules are not. A rule that passes needs a live intraday alert path (coordinator). Halal = the owner's ZAD mark.

SQ2-ORB5.name: 5-minute opening-range breakout on a 4%+ gap with 3x relative volume (day trade)

SQ2-ORB30.name: 30-minute opening-range breakout on a 4%+ gap with 3x relative volume (day trade)

SQ2-EPORB.name: Episodic pivot bought on the gap day: 10%+ gap in a neglected stock, 5-minute opening-range high, Qullamaggie exits

SQ2-QBO.name: Qullamaggie breakout bought on the intraday break of the base high (or the 5-minute opening-range high), stop at the day low so far

SQ2-VWAP.name: VWAP reclaim after a morning flush on leaders (day trade)

SQ2-EMAPB.name: First pullback to the 9/21 EMA on 5-minute bars after a 4%+ gap with 3x relative volume (day trade)

SQ2-HTF.name: High tight flag bought on the intraday break of the flag high, stop at the day low so far, 10-day trail

SQ2-PWR.name: Power-hour breakout of the day high on strong, active stocks (day trade)

SQ2-SWING.name: Swing version: 5-minute opening-range breakout on a 4%+ gap with 3x relative volume, held for days with a 10-day-low trail
